rule CobaltStrike_Beacon {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beaconing behavior"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $beacon_config = { 2E 72 63 64 2E 63 66 67 }
        $user_agent = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT" wide ascii
        $c2_http_get = "GET / HTTP/1.1" wide ascii
    condition:
        all of them
}
